title: AgentQuartz: Claude & Cursor usage in your macOS menu bar | Product Hunt
excerpt: Local-first macOS menu-bar companion for Claude and Cursor usage. Glance at limits without a browser tab. No AgentQuartz cloud account — settings stay on your machine. Free forever for essentials; Pro is a one-time $3 unlock for tray customization. Unofficial.
